findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "compare_people" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: source_check, enrich_person, get_dossier, scan_for_mentions, find_buyers_now · Private data: source_check, enrich_person, get_snapshot, get_full_report, get_dossier, compare_people, export_report, find_buyers_now · Public sink: source_check, enrich_person, get_snapshot, get_dossier, export_report · Destructive: scan_for_mentions, get_my_recent_research.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: source_check, enrich_person, get_dossier, scan_for_mentions, find_buyers_now · Private data: source_check, enrich_person, get_snapshot, get_full_report, get_dossier, compare_people, export_report, find_buyers_now · Public sink: source_check, enrich_person, get_snapshot, get_dossier, export_report · Destructive: scan_for_mentions, get_my_recent_research

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
